notes: Input generation/file IO, FP32 conversion, Metal setup/allocation/input copy, output copy and validation are outside resident execution clocks.
Apple unified memory: input/output copies are CPU memcpy to/from shared Metal buffers, not discrete-GPU PCIe transfers.
Every trial output coordinate is compared against stock JS FP64 coordinates computed from the original FP64 inputs.
All geometry engines use acos then sin/cos; GPU and CPU use FP32 inputs/edges; reference remains FP64.
GPU every timed run is followed by full output copy/validation; CPU every run by validation; this cadence differs from stock WebGL timing.
Fixed method order is GPU, CPU single, CPU multicore; warmups precede each method; no randomized interleaving.
CPU workers persist and share dynamically claimed4096-marker chunks; dispatch and completion barrier are included.
